audit.why: Lane read is right: Vex out-ranges, Galio's only engage (Justice Punch) is a dash Vex's passive fear-interrupts, his R is a roam tool, and late he tanks up but cannot lock a Vex who holds fear for the taunt. 53.65% WR over 1122 games; content/packet agree Vex on all 7 rows.

Spikes sound: 3-5 angle-poke around W, 6 Vex out-duels while Hero's Entrance roams, first item he tanks into anti-mage, late global-R team threat. Content calls his W 'Durand's Shield' — Riot's name is Shield of Durand; corrected where the parenthetical convention appears.
audit.corrected: Shield of Durand naming fixed in spikes[0].text and whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows vs content/packet Vex on all 7. Cooldowns field had no digit. Two Do's/Don'ts bodies pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad. Missing interaction now stated: Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the step-back cue.
audit.why: Justice Punch 11/7s is his only engage and a dash (feeds Doom); Shield of Durand absorbs magic burst, so angled poke beats face-poke; P is flagged autoReset.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to content with grounded whys; real cooldowns added; bleeds replaced.

edits.before: Q-poke the last-hits — the accelerating bolt chips from a deceptive range and Gloom marks tax every connect.
edits.after: You out-range him at 1 and his only engage, Justice Punch, is a dash your passive already punishes.

edits.before: W online: the shield-fear pulse means anyone who dashes onto you regrets the itinerary.
edits.after: W online: angle empowered Q past Shield of Durand — he cannot taunt what he cannot reach.

edits.before: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every passive proc is crowd control he scheduled for you.
edits.after: Full kit: any Justice Punch onto you procs Doom — fear-cancel the taunt combo before his W ever lands.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — mark-and-bolt every wave contact; the fear windows zone harder than the damage.
edits.after: Poke the sides of his shield and interrupt the 11-7s Justice Punch — he has no second engage behind it.

edits.before: Shadow Surge online — any skirmish in missile range is now your business; the reset execute travels.
edits.after: Your R out-duels him — Hero's Entrance is a roam button, and his E dash still feeds your fear in lane.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the full marked rotation chunks half bars and fears the answer. Force the gloom war.
edits.after: Luden's spike: poke around the shield's sides; never burst the tank through an active W, fear the E.

edits.before: Late Vex is anti-engage incarnate: their dive feeds your fears, your R feeds on their deaths.
edits.after: Hold fear for his flank taunt — deny the lock his kit needs and his global R stays a support tool.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, 7 at max — his only engage; no threat while it is down. - Colossal Smash is an auto-reset: the wind-up, not the cast, is your step-back cue. W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Justice Punch is a dash — it procs your passive mark on the way in, so trade with Doom banked and his engage becomes bonus damage and a fear.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Shadow Surge fired into an active Shield of Durand tickles a tank — loose it the moment the shield and taunt are both spent, not later.

edits.before: Galio wants to shield magic damage with W (Durand's Shield) and poke with Q (Winds of War), so weave in empowered Q from angles and don't waste your whole combo into an active W; when he E-dashes (Justice Punch) to taunt, your Doom passive fears and interrupts the engage.
edits.after: Galio wants to shield magic damage with W (Shield of Durand) and poke with Q (Winds of War), so weave in empowered Q from angles and don't waste your whole combo into an active W; when he E-dashes (Justice Punch) to taunt, your Doom passive fears and interrupts the engage.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep poking around Durand's Shield and interrupting his engage.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you keep poking around Shield of Durand and interrupting his engage.
